item.title: Release 0.22.0: MP3 and video playback
item.description: MicroPythonOS 0.22.0 adds MP3 playback through a native MPEG decoder, pause and seek in both players, sound from a passive piezo buzzer, native games at 56 fps, and support for the D-Shell ESP32-S3.
